gates.name: Main Gate 01
gates.description: Primary campus entrance on the east side. Visitor check-in, security screening, and shuttle drop-off.
tips: Show your student ID at the gate for faster entry.
Visitors must check in at the security desk.
Shuttle drop-off is just inside the gate, to the right.

gates.name: South Gate 02
gates.description: Secondary entrance from the south road. Convenient for South Parking Hub and the sports zone.
tips: Closest entrance to South Parking Hub and the sports zone.
Used by shuttle buses during peak hours.
Walk north along the main road to reach the Central Academic zone.

parkingHubs.name: North Parking Hub
parkingHubs.description: Main parking for the North Academic Grid and residential zone shuttle stop.
tips: Free for students with a campus parking sticker.
Best parking for the North Academic Grid (B17–B20).
Shuttle stop is at the south edge of the lot.

parkingHubs.name: South Parking Hub
parkingHubs.description: Parking serving the South Academic Grid and South Gate arrivals.
tips: Best parking for the South Academic Grid (B23–B26).
Fills up before 09:00 on weekdays.
Use South Gate 02 for the quickest exit.

parkingHubs.name: West Upper Parking Hub
parkingHubs.description: Upper west parking next to the West Academic Grid.
tips: Best parking for West Academic Grid buildings B21–B22.
2-minute walk to the west buildings.

parkingHubs.name: West Lower Parking Hub
parkingHubs.description: Lower west parking serving the West Extension buildings.
tips: Best parking for West Extension buildings B27–B30.
Follow the west access road south to reach the sports zone.

landmarks.name: Student Affairs
landmarks.description: Admissions, housing applications, student services desks, and official document requests.
tips: Bring your student ID and a printed copy of any request form.
Housing applications open at the start of each semester — apply on day one.
Most paperwork is handled at the ground-floor service desks.

landmarks.name: Central Library
landmarks.description: Four-floor central library: print collections, digital databases, group study rooms, and printing services.
tips: Your student ID is your library card — bring it.
Book group study rooms through the library portal, not at the desk.
Floor-3 printers are the most reliable; ground-floor ones jam often.

landmarks.name: Service Zone
landmarks.description: Campus services hub: bank branch, post office, pharmacy, and maintenance desk.
tips: The pharmacy is your fastest option for minor medical needs.
The bank is busiest at the start of the month — go mid-month.
Bring your ID for post office document mailing.

landmarks.name: College of Engineering (CoE)
landmarks.description: College of Engineering — main academic home for engineering departments, labs, and faculty offices.
tips: Check your lab section schedule before coming — access is by course registration.
Faculty offices are on the upper floors; the lobby directory lists room numbers.
Ask your TA about open-lab hours.

landmarks.name: Sports Field & Running Track
landmarks.description: Outdoor athletics: football field, running track, and courts for open-air PE and club training.
tips: PE sessions and club training use the track in the afternoons.
Bring water — there are no vending machines at the field.
Check the sports office schedule for reserved team slots.

landmarks.name: Student Housing / Residential Zone
landmarks.description: Residential buildings with furnished rooms, kitchenettes, laundry, and 24/7 access control.
tips: Apply for housing the day applications open — popular room types fill fast.
Bring your own kitchen basics; kitchenettes are shared per floor.
Laundry is busiest Sunday evenings — go weekday mornings.
